name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Family Reunification

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse of a Ukrainian citizen, or a family member of a foreigner legally residing in Ukraine.
Marriage certificate or documentation proving the family relationship, D visa, translated passport, and medical insurance.

evidence_required.document: D visa, translated passport, medical insurance

sources.title: State Migration Service of Ukraine, official English page -- Temporary Residence Permit, family reunification category: spouses of Ukrainian citizens and family members of legally residing foreigners, standard 1-year validity

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ukraine). citizenship_after_months (36) reflects the preferential consideration dmsu.gov.ua's own naturalisation page describes for spouses married 3+ years to a Ukrainian citizen (see ua_citizenship_naturalisation.json's notes) -- modeled as a route-level default rather than an independently confirmed fast-track figure distinct from the standard 5-year rule, since the source described this as 'preferential consideration' rather than a fixed reduced-year requirement. dual_citizenship_allowed (true) reflects the new Article 5-1 multiple-citizenship framework (effective 16 January 2026) covering, among other groups, family members connected to military service -- see ua_citizenship_dual_declaration.json for the specific mechanics; an ordinary civilian spouse case may or may not qualify for that specific declaration-based track, disclosed as an open question rather than assumed.
